classification.reason: This is an explicit refund request, which per policy must always be executed by a human manager rather than an agent.

draft.reply:
Hi, thanks for reaching out, and sorry to hear the Team plan wasn't the right fit.

Our refund policy allows full refunds when requested within 14 calendar days of the charge date. Since I'm not able to approve or process refunds myself, I've escalated your request to a member of our support management team. They'll check your charge date against the policy and take care of processing the refund if it qualifies.

You should hear back from them shortly. Thanks for your patience in the meantime!

**Citations:**
- "Our refund policy allows full refunds when requested within 14 calendar days of the charge date" — data/kb/refund_policy.md, item 1
- "I'm not able to approve or process refunds myself... escalated to a member of our support management team... they'll check your charge date... and take care of processing the refund" — data/kb/refund_policy.md, item 6 ("A support agent... may confirm the policy and check the charge date, but must never promise a refund amount or approve a refund outright. Refunds are only executed by a manager through the billing system.")
